request.initial_prompt: _Fal._ So did I mine, to build upon a foolish woman's promise.

raw_segments.text: Host, to see thee fight, to see thee foyne, to see thee traverse, to see thee here, to see thee there, to see thee pass thy punto, thy stock, thy reverse, thy distance, thy montant.
Is he dead, my Ethiopian? Is he dead, my Francisco? Twenty-five ha, bully. What says my Aesculapius? My Galen? My heart of Elder? Ha! Is he dead, bully-stale? Is he dead?
